detail.requirements:
• 5+ years of working experience in Business Analytics, Data Analysis, Sales Operations support, BI/reporting functions, or related quantitative roles
• Strong proficiency in Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP, data manipulation) and familiarity with BI/dashboard tools (e.g., QuickSight, Tableau, Power BI)
• Proficiency in both Korean and English (written and verbal)
• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple tasks concurrently, prioritize effectively, and deliver accurate results on time
• Strong attention to detail with a data-driven, problem-solving mindset
• Structured communication skills to collaborate effectively with team members and stakeholders
• 5+ years of Microsoft Excel experience
• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
• Experience with sales CRM tools such as Salesforce or similar software
• Experience defining, refining and implementing sales processes, procedures and policies or equivalent
detail.main_tasks:
• Extract and consolidate data from SFDC, QuickSight, and internal BI tools to prepare weekly/monthly business review materials (WBR/MBR/QBR), including revenue performance, and pipeline coverage
• Create and maintain operational dashboards, data packs, and performance tracking reports for the Korea sales leadership team
• Support ad hoc data analysis requests and maintain data integrity across reporting tools, flagging discrepancies for resolution
• Drive efficiency improvements by automating recurring data workflows using BI tools
detail.intro: We are looking for a Business Analyst to join our AWS Korea Global Sales Operations (GSO). In this role, you will support the Korea GSO and field sales team by executing data analysis, report generation, and operational tasks as directed by the Sales Operations leadership. You will work with structured data from SFDC, QuickSight, and internal BI tools to produce weekly and monthly business review materials, pipeline reports, and performance dashboards that enable Korea sales leadership to make informed decisions.
detail.preferred_points:
• Experience in IT industry or cloud computing environment
• Familiarity with Salesforce (SFDC) reporting and data structures
• Experience preparing materials for executive business reviews
• Operational excellence mindset - proactively identifies process improvements and automation opportunities
• Proven track record of taking ownership and delivering results with minimal supervision
• 5+ years of finance, business management and sales operations experience
• Experience working within a high-growth, technology company

job.position: Sales Operation Business Analyst - Full Time Contract, GSO (Global Sales Operation)
